effect.name: GM Woven Crosshatch
effect.desc: Four-direction woven hatch layers that progressively fill shadows while retaining colored highlights.
effect.shader: float stripe(vec2 uv,float a,float d){return 1.0-smoothstep(lineWidth,lineWidth+.08,abs(fract(dot(uv,vec2(cos(a),sin(a)))*density+d)-.5));}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);float l=dot(src.rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722)),dark=pow(1.0-l,shadowDepth);float h1=stripe(uv,angle,0.0)*step(.18,dark),h2=stripe(uv,angle+1.5708,.2)*step(.4,dark),h3=stripe(uv,angle+.7854,.4)*step(.62,dark),h4=stripe(uv,angle-.7854,.6)*step(.82,dark);float ink=clamp(h1+h2+h3+h4,0.0,1.0);vec3 base=mix(paperColor.rgb,paperColor.rgb*src.rgb,colorRetention);vec3 result=mix(base,inkColor.rgb,ink);gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,result,mixAmount),src.a);}
